name.description: This is the name of credential. This is just for your reference.

gateways.description: This is the list of SIP trunk's gateways.

outboundAuthenticationPlan.description: This can be used to configure the outbound authentication if required by the SIP trunk.

outboundLeadingPlusEnabled.description:
This ensures the outbound origination attempts have a leading plus. Defaults to false to match conventional telecom behavior.

Usage:
- Vonage/Twilio requires leading plus for all outbound calls. Set this to true.

@default false

techPrefix.description: This can be used to configure the tech prefix on outbound calls. This is an advanced property.

sipDiversionHeader.description: This can be used to enable the SIP diversion header for authenticating the calling number if the SIP trunk supports it. This is an advanced property.

sbcConfiguration.description: This is an advanced configuration for enterprise deployments. This uses the onprem SBC to trunk into the SIP trunk's `gateways`, rather than the managed SBC provided by Vapi.
